installRoutes.title: installRoutes
installRoutes.description:
Install routes learned from BGP neighbors into the Linux routing table. Defaults to true.
When false, learned routes remain in this instance’s BGP RIB and can still be selected by
importRoutes, but Talos does not install them into the Linux FIB.
installRoutes.markdownDescription:
Install routes learned from BGP neighbors into the Linux routing table. Defaults to true.
When false, learned routes remain in this instance's BGP RIB and can still be selected by
`importRoutes`, but Talos does not install them into the Linux FIB.
installRoutes.x-intellij-html-description: Install routes learned from BGP neighbors into the Linux routing table. Defaults to true. When false, learned routes remain in this instance’s BGP RIB and can still be selected by importRoutes, but Talos does not install them into the Linux FIB.

importRoutes.title: importRoutes
importRoutes.description:
Selected routes to import from other BGP instances. Imports are one-way: matching best paths
learned from each source instance are preserved and advertised by this instance with its own
next hop. Locally originated and previously imported paths are not recursively imported.
Selectors in a single target instance must not overlap, giving each imported prefix one source.
importRoutes.markdownDescription:
Selected routes to import from other BGP instances. Imports are one-way: matching best paths
learned from each source instance are preserved and advertised by this instance with its own
next hop. Locally originated and previously imported paths are not recursively imported.
Selectors in a single target instance must not overlap, giving each imported prefix one source.
importRoutes.x-intellij-html-description: Selected routes to import from other BGP instances. Imports are one-way: matching best paths learned from each source instance are preserved and advertised by this instance with its own next hop. Locally originated and previously imported paths are not recursively imported. Selectors in a single target instance must not overlap, giving each imported prefix one source.
